Dr. Rowe shows a simple trick to help eliminate lower back pain caused from muscle spasms and knots.

This exercise focuses on a really easy self-massage technique that only needs something small and round (like a tennis ball), and may give relief within 30 seconds. 

Let us know how it works for you!
